question: Should Crabbox accept capability-aware AWS promoted-image selection as core CLI/coordinator API now, including the fail-closed route and promotion catalog?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but the new flags, request fields, route behavior, and durable catalog shape become a user-facing compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept After Release Cleanup
options.body: Proceed with this direction after removing the direct CHANGELOG.md edit and waiting for normal CI/review completion.

options.title: Narrow Or Defer Contract
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers reduce the initial API/storage scope or require more upgrade proof.

options.title: Decline Core Surface
options.body: Close or split the feature if capability-aware image matching should stay outside core for now.

recommendation.title: Accept After Release Cleanup
recommendation.body: Proceed with this direction after removing the direct CHANGELOG.md edit and waiting for normal CI/review completion.

likelyOwner.reason: The same person is tied to current AWS image-provider history and authored the proposed contract, making them the best available routing owner for the product/API call.
